title: Little Weather Station
hook: Measure, look, and sing with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two short beats before answer confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D preschool weather-station storybook, simple instruments and sky backdrop, bright educational colors, clean contours

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a playful junior weather watcher noticing sky motion, clothing and simple instruments
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: memorable two-line thematic reset with child-compatible echo

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses forecast-style cue-gap-answer timing and weather-specific hand motions; instruments/technical objects are pointed to or mimed safely.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
